title: What is an action in automation? Plain answer | 50agents
description: An action is one thing software does in an app for you: add a row, send a message, update a deal. Why each app's list of actions sets what you can automate.
h1: What is an action in automation?
definition: An action is one thing software does in an app on your behalf: add a row, send a message, update a deal.
Each app offers a fixed list of actions, so what an automation or an AI agent can do in that app is set by that list.

example.ask: Set up an automation: every new HubSpot contact is added as a row to my Google Sheet and posted in a Slack channel
example.why: One trigger, two actions: Google Sheets' add a row, then Slack's send a message. Captain reads each app's real list of actions while planning, so the plan names only actions that exist.
